evidence_quotes.O: Design has moved a long way in the last few years, especially for less expensive computers.
evidence_quotes.C: I spent extensive time trying to decide between this model, the SR7 and the CX7.
evidence_quotes.E: I'm elated to learn from a Logitech forum post that this camera will be supporting Skype HQ with release of Skype 5.0!
evidence_quotes.A: I work in the IT industry, so every time people move offices they come to me for a power strip.
evidence_quotes.N: I also really cringed at the idea of running wires for a full surround system.
